import binascii
POLY_REF=0xEDB88320
POLY_NORM=0x04C11DB7
def crc_ref(bits):
    crc=0xFFFFFFFF

        fb=(crc&1)^b
        crc=(crc>>1) ^ (POLY_REF if fb else 0)
        crc&=0xFFFFFFFF
    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) & 0xFFFFFFFF
def crc_norm(bits):
    crc=0xFFFFFFFF
    for b in bits:
        fb=((crc>>31)&1)^b

        crc&=0xFFFFFFFF

    return [(v>>p)&1 for p in order]
